name: Mammon
role: Infernal council voice for exploiting Hell's resources; leads the gold-mining that supplies Pandemonium
description: Category A+D: biblical origin as a personification of wealth, not a named deity (Matthew 6:24/Luke 16:13, Aramaic 'mamona'). Milton is chiefly responsible for turning Mammon into a fully personified character with a backstory -- in Heaven he was always looking down at the gold pavement rather than up at God's face. He supplies the ore; the architect who actually designs Pandemonium is a separate figure, Mulciber (keep distinct). See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §II.
narrative_function: Argues in Book II for making the best of Hell rather than war or despair; oversees Pandemonium's construction.
